tailoring.headline: Manager eCommerce Platform | SAP Commerce Cloud Developer & Techno-Functional Consultant
tailoring.summary: Techno-functional SAP Commerce Cloud Developer with 5+ years of enterprise experience building, extending and supporting large e-commerce platforms (Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring, OCC REST APIs, PIM/ERP integrations, and database performance tuning. Proven expertise bridging business requirements and technical execution, managing international stakeholders, and leading agile delivery with AI-assisted workflows. SAP Certified Professional.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

keywords_missing: Global team leadership in lubricants industry

cover_en.subject: Application: Manager eCommerce Platform (m/w/d)
cover_en.hook: Driving enterprise e-commerce excellence at FUCHS as Manager eCommerce Platform represents an exciting opportunity to apply my extensive backend and platform architecture expertise. With over 5 years of professional experience building, extending, and supporting large SAP Commerce Cloud platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep technical proficiency and a strong techno-functional approach to scaling digital storefronts.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce Architecture & Development
bullets.text: Designed and implemented backend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud 2211 using Java and Spring, covering product, catalog, pricing, and customer data management following platform best practices.

bullets.label: Integrations & API Management
bullets.text: Engineered PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines using Profisee, Hotfolders, and DataHub, while resolving complex integration bottlenecks between SAP ERP, MDM, and e-commerce channels.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Leadership
bullets.text: Bridged business requirements and IT execution by analysing processes, writing user stories, and translating stakeholder needs into robust SAP Commerce solutions alongside international teams.

bullets.label: Performance & DevOps Delivery
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles on CCv2, led database query refactoring to reduce latency, and maintained high platform stability across global enterprise environments.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe with a valid German residence and work permit, I am serving my notice period with a last working day on 15.12.2026 and am available to start on 16.12.2026. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my SAP Commerce expertise adds value to FUCHS.

cover_de.subject: Bewerbung als Manager eCommerce Platform (m/w/d)
cover_de.hook: Als erfahrene SAP Commerce Cloud Developerin mit über fünf Jahren nachweisbarer Praxis bei Unternehmen wie Rockwell Automation und Shell reizt mich die Position als Manager eCommerce Platform bei FUCHS außerordentlich. Ich bringe fundierte Java- und Spring-Expertise, tiefgehendes Plattform-Know-how sowie eine starke techno-funktionale Arbeitsweise mit, um digitale Vertriebsplattformen erfolgreich weiterzuentwickeln.

bullets.label: Plattform-Architektur & Entwicklung
bullets.text: Entwicklung und Implementierung von Backend- und Frontendsystemen auf SAP Commerce Cloud 2105 und 2211 mittels Java und Spring mit Fokus auf Produkt-, Katalog- und Preisdatenmanagement.

bullets.label: Integrationen & Schnittstellen
bullets.text: Konzeption und Optimierung von PIM-zu-Hybris-Datenpipelines unter Verwendung von Profisee, Hotfolders und DataHub sowie Behebung von Integrationsengpässen zwischen SAP ERP und MDM.

bullets.label: Techno-Funktionale Analyse
bullets.text: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Business-Stakeholdern zur Anforderungsanalyse, Erstellung von User Stories und funktionalen Spezifikationen sowie Übersetzung in skalierbare E-Commerce-Lösungen.

bullets.label: DevOps & Performance-Tuning
bullets.text: Ausführung von CI/CD-Deployments auf CCv2, Durchführung von Datenbank-Query-Refactorings zur Latenzreduzierung sowie Sicherstellung eines stabilen Betriebs.

cover_de.logistics: Ich wohne in Karlsruhe, besitze eine unbeschränkte deutsche Arbeitserlaubnis und stehe nach Ablauf meiner Kündigungsfrist ab dem 16.12.2026 (letzter Arbeitstag 15.12.2026) zur Verfügung. Ich freue mich auf ein persönliches Gespräch.

tailoring.why_company: FUCHS is a global leader in lubricants with a strong commitment to digital innovation and customer-centric platforms. Managing and scaling enterprise e-commerce solutions in such a specialized manufacturing environment requires robust architecture, seamless ERP/PIM integrations, and precise stakeholder alignment—challenges that directly match my 5+ years of SAP Commerce expertise.
tailoring.motivation_short: Leveraging 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud and integration expertise at Rockwell Automation and Shell to drive scalable, high-performance digital platforms at FUCHS.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello! With 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I build scalable e-commerce platforms and integrate PIM/ERP systems. As I am exploring new opportunities with a start date of 16.12.2026, I would love to connect regarding the Manager eCommerce Platform role.
tailoring.email_subject: Application: Manager eCommerce Platform (m/w/d) – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my application documents for the Manager eCommerce Platform position at FUCHS. With over 5 years of professional experience building, extending, and supporting enterprise SAP Commerce Cloud platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring strong technical depth in Java, Spring, and OCC REST APIs, alongside proven techno-functional expertise in PIM and ERP integrations.

I possess a valid German work permit and am available starting 16.12.2026. I look forward to discussing my background with you.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
